final: WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT a.translink) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, 1.0 * transaction_count / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts
